name: openchara
description: Open character framework for Minecraft Bedrock add-ons: character database, squads, tactical AI, progression and UI base - content comes from project PATCHES.

scripts.check-engine: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('engine/scripts/openchara')) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'engine/scripts/openchara/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
